book.title: DIR PASA Dir pasa Yesus Kristusŋge te-mayokna

content: Kuate tuku minyo mbili maditaknu te-ŋgamude mbal

Ye kuasmbi 7 tuku wam pagu pasa ta ise deŋpurmba kile ye maŋ kiŋatanu suk samba mbolŋge malaŋga ande talok minna le kaŋgeren sulumba ŋin tugu amboŋga tabil wi suk pasa sayina ta maŋ isen. Nu teŋenmba sayina. Ne ye tugum te mbambe le wam kame prowamŋgaig ta tumnamŋgit ŋgina.
Taŋakina le Tukul Guwa ye mbol kumuŋgina le ye samba mbolŋge minyo mbili maditaknu minna le ande nyu suŋgo ŋak minyo mbili ta mbolŋge minyokina le kaŋgeren.
Minyo mbili ta mbolŋge minyok minna taŋgo ta nu ndame ar yasper le karnelian kaŋgerkanu taŋaŋ uge liŋnu ndo. Wanzu ndame uge liŋnu emerald taŋaŋ tiŋga minyo mbili laipmba minna le kaŋgeren.

Minyo mbili 24 minyo mbili maditaknu ta laipmba te-ŋgamumba minnaig le kaŋgerken. Minyo mbili kame ta mbolŋge taŋgo mage mage nyu ŋak tawi kugennu kaukauk siglika gol hat kaikanu minyok minnaig le kaŋgerken.
Minyo mbili maditaknu tugumŋge teliŋ tuku bulu lato lato promba fudu sugo kuaila turmba fudukinaig le isen. Minyo mbili tumailamŋge sati 7 buluŋga minnaig le kaŋgerken. Sati 7 ta Kuate tuku guwa 7.

Minyo mbili tumailamŋge ma ande yu suk glas taŋaŋ liŋleŋkanu kaŋgeren. Agaŋ bailkamba abo ŋak minyo mbili maditaknu ta laipmba minnaig le kaŋgerken. Agaŋ kame ta am gudommba ŋak. Ŋgumnemŋge tumailamŋge amŋge ndo kumuŋganu minnaig le kaŋgerken.
Agaŋ bailkamba ta ande laion suk ande makau pailnu suk ande tumailnu taŋgo tumail suk ande nu paŋus buŋga minanu suk.
Nane salmban 6 ŋak. Naŋgine ŋgarosu amŋge ndo kumuŋganu. Nane furir mindek ki mindek mune ulmba teŋenmba sakade.

content.text: O Suŋgo Kuate ne saŋgri ŋayo. Ande ne linam kumuŋ kuga.
Ne buk minna kile minit taŋamba minmba minamŋgat ŋgade.

content: Kuate abo ŋak minmba minit ta nu minyo mbili maditaknu mbolŋge minyokate le agaŋ bailkamba abo ŋak ta nu mayenu ŋga gare pasa tumba nu tuku nyu te-duŋgade le
taŋgo mage 24 nyu ŋak ta mata nane nu tumailamŋge truk ka nu tuku nyu te-duŋgade. Nane naŋgine gol hat paska minyo mbili tugumŋge panka teŋenmba mune ulig.

content.text: O siŋgine Suŋgo Kuate, ne agaŋ ndende ŋakmba kile-mayokkina.
Ne naŋe nzali dubimba agaŋ ndende kile-mayokkina le kile minig. Ne saŋgri ŋakmba ŋak. Sine kumumbi ne tuku nyu te-duŋgeg ŋgade.
